entities.summary: Marie Crous was a French mathematician. She is known for two publications: a 1636 study in which she contributed to the further development of arithmetic using decimal fractions, and a 1641 textbook of practical arithmetic rules. She proposed the introduction of the decimal system in France as early as 1636.
